device.description: 8-bit I2C I/O expander with interrupt output

registers.description: Pin direction. 1 = input, 0 = output. All pins are inputs after reset.
registers.name: IODIR

registers.description: Input polarity. 1 = the GPIO register reflects the inverted pin value.
registers.name: IPOL

registers.description: Default comparison value, used when INTCON selects comparison mode
registers.name: DEFVAL

registers.description: Interrupt control. 1 = compare against DEFVAL, 0 = compare against the previous value.
registers.name: INTCON

registers.description: Device configuration. Note there is no BANK bit here -- with a single port there is nothing to re-bank.

fields.description: Sequential operation disable. 1 = the address pointer does not increment.
fields.name: SEQOP

fields.description: Hardware address enable. No effect on the I2C part; present for the SPI variant.
fields.name: HAEN

fields.description: 1 = INT pin is open drain, overriding INTPOL
fields.name: ODR

fields.description: INT pin polarity when ODR is 0. 0 = active low, 1 = active high.
fields.name: INTPOL

registers.name: IOCON

registers.description: 100 kOhm pull-up enable, per pin, on pins configured as inputs
registers.name: GPPU

registers.description: Interrupt flags. 1 = this pin caused the interrupt. Read-only.
registers.name: INTF

registers.description: Port value captured at the time of the interrupt. Cleared by reading INTCAP or GPIO.
registers.name: INTCAP

registers.description: Port value. Reading returns the pin state; writing modifies the output latch.
registers.name: GPIO

registers.description: Output latch. Reading returns the latch, not the pin.
registers.name: OLAT

provenance.notes: Hand-authored seed entry, not machine-extracted. Check against Microchip MCP23008/MCP23S08 datasheet (DS21919) before trusting it, then mark it verified.
